overview: DilSe is a mobile-first dating app where adults 18+ build a profile, discover compatible partners, match, chat privately and upgrade to premium.
features: Sign in securely and complete an 18+ age-gated profile
Upload photos and describe yourself with bio, interests and partner preferences
Discover compatible profiles with city and age filters and smart recommendations
Like or pass profiles and get a match when the feeling is mutual
Chat privately with matches, share images, block and report
Upgrade to premium for unlimited likes, who liked you, boosts and advanced filters
Pay securely for monthly or yearly plans with automatic activation
Get in-app notifications for matches, messages, likes and subscription expiry
Admin dashboard for users, verification, complaints, bans, revenue and ads
Privacy policy and terms with no public phone numbers or exact locations
